## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector participation (10/11) alongside major large-cap divergences (multiple mega-caps showing 1W up / 1M down), supporting a neutral, wait-for-confirmation stance; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Financials lead: C (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +7.72%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +4.99% | 1M: +1.16%) ABOVE TREND. Technology strong: INTC (1W: +17.74% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +10.39%) ABOVE TREND. Real Estate showing strength but more mixed participation: CCI (1W: +10.15% | 1M: -2.73%) RECOVERY.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -4.46% | 1M: +8.36%) CORRECTION and CVX (1W: -5.82% | 1M: +4.72%) CORRECTION reflect trend exhaustion. Communication shows weakness: TMUS (1W: -5.79% | 1M: -9.94%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary has pronounced downside: NKE (1W: -14.29% | 1M: -24.11%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: INTC (1W: +17.74% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND; BA (1W: +11.43% | 1M: -4.40%) RECOVERY; NEM (1W: +10.51% | 1M: -2.81%) RECOVERY; PANW (1W: +10.16% | 1M: -0.74%) RECOVERY; CCI (1W: +10.15% | 1M: -2.73%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: MPC (1W: -4.17% | 1M: +11.06%) CORRECTION; EOG (1W: -4.35% | 1M: +9.17%) CORRECTION; XOM (1W: -4.46% | 1M: +8.36%) CORRECTION; UL (1W: -5.63% | 1M: -16.86%) BELOW TREND; TMUS (1W: -5.79% | 1M: -9.94%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Energy and select defensives/communications.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Largest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +17.74% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +11.43% | 1M: -4.40%) RECOVERY, NEM (1W: +10.51% | 1M: -2.81%) RECOVERY. Note MAJOR divergence among mega-caps — AAPL (1W: +4.04% | 1M: -0.55%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +4.52% | 1M: -9.20%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: +6.04% | 1M: -3.10%) RECOVERY — tactical signal, watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed, short-term bounce profile: INTC (1W: +17.74% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +10.39%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +6.04% | 1M: -3.10%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: +9.35% | 1M: -0.23%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +9.00% | 1M: -13.18%) RECOVERY — breadth supportive but many leaders are 1W/1M divergent.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Constructive: C (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +7.72%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +4.99% | 1M: +1.16%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.64% | 1M: -5.15%) RECOVERY — Financials are a clear component of current participation and support the neutral regime.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Generally positive but mixed: JNJ (1W: +0.22% | 1M: +0.56%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +8.62% | 1M: -1.81%) RECOVERY, LLY (1W: +5.56% | 1M: -5.72%) RECOVERY — defensive names intact while select biopharma shows bounce.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Neutral posture: favor Financials and select Technology names showing confirmed ABOVE TREND (C, INTC, AMD) and reduce exposure to Energy names showing CORRECTION (XOM, CVX) and deeply weak consumer names (NKE). Given the major mega-cap divergences, treat new positions as tactical until multi-week confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +17.74% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +7.72%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +8.62% | 1M: -1.81%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: NKE (1W: -14.29% | 1M: -24.11%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -5.79% | 1M: -9.94%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -4.46% | 1M: +8.36%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Financials (part of the 10/11 sector participation) and Technology for 1W momentum. BEARISH: Energy (1W weakness vs 1M strength suggests pullback risk) and Consumer Discretionary for downside concentration.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: +6.04% | 1M: -3.10%) RECOVERY — needs follow-through above this week's high to confirm multi-week turn. C (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +7.72%) ABOVE TREND — watch continuation above recent breakout for sustained Financials leadership. NKE (1W: -14.29% | 1M: -24.11%) BELOW TREND — breach of this week’s lows would signal deeper discretionary stress.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
NVDA (+55): NVDA (1W: +6.04% | 1M: -3.10%) RECOVERY — positive headlines on In-Orbit AI and price action confirming. UNH (+55): UNH (1W: +8.62% | 1M: -1.81%) RECOVERY — Medicare reimbursement boost and price confirming. AAPL (+50): AAPL (1W: +4.04% | 1M: -0.55%) RECOVERY — iPhone 17 sales note aligns with recent price bounce.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
PSX (-60): PSX (1W: -5.82% | 1M: +6.54%) CORRECTION — hedging-loss headline and price decline are confirming. MA (-50): MA (1W: +3.56% | 1M: -4.41%) RECOVERY — analyst cut contrasts with 1W strength, watch for divergence. LLY (-50): LLY (1W: +5.56% | 1M: -5.72%) RECOVERY — competitive pricing pressure vs short-term price bounce; monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. C (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +7.72%) ABOVE TREND and INTC (1W: +17.74% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major mega-cap 1W/1M divergences (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, META RECOVERY) and mixed sentiment on MA/LLY — watch for trend confirmation.
